## [0.4.1] - 2026-11-24
### Changed - Limited Finder Sync directory observation to the startup volume (`/`) instead of registering other mounted volumes, so Buckle no longer replaces Finder sidebar icons for external drives, disk images, or network volumes.

## [0.4.0] - 2026-11-16
### Added - Optional New Text File Finder action creates and selects an empty text file in a single folder, using numbered names without overwriting existing files and rejecting replayed creation requests across restarts. - Optional middle-click quitting for running apps in the Dock, with synchronized menu-bar and General switches, permission status, and a menu-bar action choice saved between launches: normal quit by default, or force quit with confirmation each time and app-instance revalidation.
### Changed - Added matching native color icons for Open in Terminal, Copy Path, Move Items Here, and New Text File in Finder context menus and the menu-bar menu; AirDrop keeps its system icon. - Documented how to clear the setup dismissal record when uninstalling so setup appears after reinstalling; normal upgrades preserve it.

## [0.3.1] - 2026-11-15
### Changed - Removed the setup guide reopen button from General settings; first-run setup still appears once. - Added spacing above the mouse reset wait description and styled it as secondary text.
